reason: The free pilot is the hook: I like trying new tools and one small task costs me nothing. I would not pay the 55 USDC after that unless the free run showed me something clearly better than a model draft.
objection: Writing a good rubric for every task is extra work for me, and I have to pay in USDC on Solana, which I would have to set up. It is also unaudited, invite-only and run by a small team, so I would not put real money in yet.
would_change_my_mind: A ready-made rubric template for copy tasks, so I don't have to write one from scratch, plus paying by card instead of USDC.
